name: P8I
description: "The first integrated SACD/CD player in DCs.In order to realize perfect digital data processing, we pursue bit-perfect data reading and transmission.In the case of general equipment, when there is a missing part in the read data, the operation is carried out by the original program at that stage to supplement the missing part. However, in DCs, it is an absolute condition that the bit perfect data without the missing part is sent to the next conversion stage as it is. In order to realize this, the accuracy of the pickup program and mechanism is verified by reading approximately 64000 codes, and the bit perfect data is transmitted to the DAC section by adding the original software.A 5-bit, 2.822MS/s ring DAC is used for the DA conversion section, and the signal is converted into an analog signal without missing, manipulating or correcting data.The ring DAC has the advantage of excellent linearity, but it incorporates only the advantages of a 1-bit system which tends to generate clock error due to switching and generates noise and distortion, and a multi-bit converter which has a problem of linearity at a low level due to drift caused by time variation due to the resistor accuracy hurdle even though it is low noise.Equipped with digital input terminal, input from other transport can be used as DCs DAC with upsampling function.The clock circuit uses a carefully selected quartz oscillator VCXO clock.In addition, the word clock input terminal is mounted in order to support high-precision clock and synchronous operation with different DACs.Equipped with a digital output terminal.Each analog output has one balanced and one unbalanced system.The output level can be converted into 2 v and 6 v according to the operating conditions.Hybrid SACD discs are designed to play SACD first.PCM CD is upsampled into DSD data and converted into analog.The panel part is machined out of thick hard aluminum.The function buttons change to purple, red, green and blue depending on the status of SACD, CD, standby and menu, so that you can check the status of the P8i and the playing disc at a glance.There are 2 variations of the appearance, black and Platinum."

name: SCARLATTITRANSPORT
description: "Scarlatti Series SACD/CD transport.The mechanism part is equipped with Ecotheric's VRDS-Neo, which has an order of magnitude higher fidelity than currently available mechanisms.In addition, in order to bring out the capability of the VDDS-Neo mechanism to the maximum, the signal processing circuit was made completely new, and the FPDA and DSP used at that time were also newly designed.The basic control board uses an 8-layer board called V7, and the transport ideal for DCs is realized with a completely new power supply.In addition to IEEE1394 transmission of DSD data, DSD conversion of PCM data of PCM data and selection of readout layer of hybrid disk.Word clock input / output is mounted.In combination with DAC and clock of the same series, the best sound quality can be obtained, and it is also compatible with other DCs devices and lockable DAC of other companies."

name: SCARLATTIDAC
description: "Scarlatti series DSD/PCM D/A converter.Scarlatti DAC supports 24/88.1, 24/96, 24/176.2, and 24/192 data-processing.In addition, DSD signals can be processed as is via IEEE1394 or SDIF interfaces.The D/A converter is equipped with a patented ring DAC.With the ring DAC, data processing is performed by oversampling at 2.822MS/s with a sample rate of 5 bits, and the dynamic range is expanded to realize more realistic music playback.In addition, the latest high-speed FPGA and DSP are produced in a unique format, and the 7th generation 8-layer board is used for the control board.An excellent D/A converter has been realized by using a ring DAC as the core, digitizing a phase-locked loop and newly polishing circuits such as a class A analog output.The IEEE1394 interface supports DSD data transfer, receives from transport and up-samplers such as DCs Scarlatti and Verdi, and directly converts the DSD format to analog.DSD processing from the transport of other companies is not carried out because the transport of each company which is a latecomer adopts the software standard different from DCs.Word clock input / output is mounted."

name: SCARLATTICLOCK
description: "Master clock generator of Scarlatti series.By synchronizing the D/A converter and transport with a stable master clock with high accuracy, better playback is possible.A dual oscillator system is used for the circuit, and an aged crystal oscillator (VCXOx2) is selected and used as a match pair. Since each crystal has a different drift tendency, it is necessary to select and match over a long period of time. Each master clock unit is built up by inputting the individual characteristics and characteristics into the internal DSP to improve stability against temperature and secular change.Eight output terminals are provided. Each of these terminals is equipped with a buffer to block defective components flowing back from the connected equipment.Crystal oscillation produces frequencies from 22.5792 or 24.5760 or MHz to 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz. The supporting control board is equipped with a newly designed high-speed FPGA, DSP and newly designed power supply. This enables high-speed start-up of less than 2 nanoseconds and greatly reduces jitter.For higher precision, it is also possible to receive signals from external oscillators such as atomic clocks.The Scarlatti Clock had an upgrade kit.Upgrades include a new USB2.0B-type connector and support for 24/192kS/s PCM and DSD packaged in DOp format."
